summary: Weights & Biases enterprise pilot: 50 seats, SCIM group sync, and billing tag alignment
description:
Issue summary: The ML research org requests procurement of a 12-month Weights & Biases (W&B) enterprise pilot (approx. 50 seats) with SCIM provisioning from Okta, automatic group-to-team mapping, and billing metadata tags for cost center reporting. This ticket coordinates procurement, IT identity integration, and finance tagging for renewal alignment.

Required by: ML Research and Platform teams for Q2 experimentation and reproducible training experiments.

Context: W&B will replace a mix of ad-hoc personal accounts and a small team plan. We need centralized seat management, SSO/SCIM automation, and invoice tagging to the ML cost center to avoid manual chargeback overhead.
impact: Without centralized seats and SCIM we risk: inconsistent experiment tracking, data residency concerns for shared project access, and manual invoice allocation tasks for finance. The pilot will affect ~6 teams and ~50 users initially. Non-action may delay experiments scheduled for the internal ML hack week (2026-04-06 to 2026-04-10).
business_justification: Centralized W&B seats will improve reproducibility for models, allow team-level access controls, and provide audit logs for experiments. Expected to reduce time lost to ad-hoc sharing by ~20% and enable platform team to standardize artifact exports into Redwood's model registry. Finance has approved pilot spend within the 'ML platform experiments' budget (ENG-ML-TS).
requested_configuration:
- 50 named seats (enterprise pilot)
- SCIM integration via Okta with group sync: Okta group 'redwood-ml-research' -> W&B team 'Research'
- SSO via SAML (Okta) enabled
- Admins: Maya Chen (requester), Priya Nair (ML Platform)
- Billing: monthly invoice to Redwood Finance, cost center tag ENG-ML-TS
- Data retention and export: ensure project-level export privileges for Platform team
- Renewal alignment: 12-month term starting upon billing activation
billing_information: Charge to cost center ENG-ML-TS. Finance contact: Jorge Martinez (Finance). Approved purchase order number: PO-2026-ML-145 (pending vendor invoice). Requesting monthly invoicing. Procurement contact: procurement@redwood.ai
acceptance_criteria:
- 50 seats provisioned and visible in W&B admin console
- SCIM mapping automatically creates and removes seats based on Okta group membership
- SAML SSO works for at least 3 pilot users across orgs
- Invoice received with cost center tag ENG-ML-TS and matches PO number
- Admins have export/access rights verified by Platform team
steps:
1) Procurement submits vendor request and negotiates terms (Maya/Procurement)
2) Finance confirms billing cadence and cost center mapping (Jorge)
3) IT schedules SCIM/SAML setup window and shares test Okta group (Liam)
4) W&B vendor performs tenant provisioning and sends test invoice
5) Platform team runs pilot onboarding for 6 teams and performs acceptance checklist
6) Close ticket and schedule renewal reminder 60 days prior to term end
